body.statement: Using the handle in Definition \(\mathrm{def:uniform\mbox{-}gmm\mbox{-}handle}\), establish whether, for every \(\epsilon>0\), \[\sup_{m\in\mathfrak M_6}P_m\!\left(\left\|\sqrt n(\widehat\theta_{n,m}-\theta(m))+(J_m^\top S_m^{-1}J_m)^{-1}J_m^\top S_m^{-1}\frac1{\sqrt n}\sum_{i=1}^n\psi_m(X_{i,m}^{\mathrm{obs}})\right\|>\epsilon\right)\longrightarrow0,\] and \(\sup_{m\in\mathfrak M_6}P_m(\|\widehat V_{n,m}-V_m\|>\epsilon)\to0\).
body.justification: Uniform linearization is the unresolved bridge from algebraic identification to honest repeated-sampling inference with estimated centered cumulants and weights.
body.gap: Hansen and Mesters and Zwiernik provide pointwise GMM limits, and Jiang provides a pointwise smooth-map cumulant limit; none proves this uniform same-sample feasible expansion.
body.consumer: Applied users obtain a theorem-backed standard error for the two reported outer coefficients and observable warnings when regularity margins are small.
